CommunityApplications.Profile: Templates for Mediarium, an all-in-one, self-hosted media manager for movies, TV, music, ebooks and audiobooks: search, download (built-in Usenet downloader and torrent client), unpack and organise into your library from one web interface. Open source under AGPL-3.0. Questions and problems: use the Support link on the app, or open an issue on GitHub.
